contentBlocks.text: Uphambiwe — Ukuthetha Ntoni Kwisibonelelo Sakho SeSASSA

Isimo 'sokuPhambiwe' yile nto ubukade uyilinde. Kuthetha ukuba iSASSA igqibe ukuhlolwa kwayo kokuqinisekisa, kwaye iqinisekisile ukuba uyahlangabezana neemfuno zokufaneleka kule nyanga, kwaye yabela imali yentlawulo yakho. Oku kukucoceka kokugqibela phambi kokuba imali yakho ithunyelwe kwibhanki yakho okanye kwindawo yokufumana imali.
Esi simo singabaxhamli beSASSA ezizicelo zabo zezibonelelo ziye zaphononongwa zaza zagunyazwa ngempumelelo ukuze zihlawulwe.

contentBlocks.title: Isibonelelo Sakho Sigunyaziwe
contentBlocks.text: Iintlawulo ziyakhutshwa ngokwe-shedyuli yokuhlawula esemthethweni yeSASSA. Ngokuqhelekileyo imali ibonakala kwiintsuku ezi-1-3 zomsebenzi emva komhla wokuhlawula.

contentBlocks.explanation: Isicelo sakho sipasile kuzo zonke izinto zokuqinisekisa: isazisi sakho sihambelana neerekhodi zeHome Affairs, iinkcukacha zakho zebhanki ziye zaqinisekiswa ngempumelelo, uvavanyo lweendlela zobomi lubonise ukuba akukho mali engenayo engakufanelekiyo, kwaye akukho maki zoqhankqalazo ezaphakanyiswa. Ngoku iSASSA ikubandakanyile kwiqela lokuhlawula lale nyanga.
whyItHappens: Ukuqinisekiswa kwesazisi kupasile kwibhasi yedatha yeHome Affairs
Uvavanyo lweendlela zobomi luqinisekisile ukuba umvuzo wakho ungaphakathi komda
Akukho mithombo yenkxaso yeUIF, NSFAS, okanye eminye efunyenweyo
contentBlocks.howLongItLasts: Isimo 'sokuPhambiwe' sihleli de kucutshulwe intlawulo ize igqithiselwe kwibhanki yakho okanye kwiarhente yakho yokuhlawula. Xa sele uhlawuliwe, isimo sitshintsha sibe 'kuPhambeka kwentlawulo' okanye 'kuhlawulwe'. Inyanga nganye entsha ivavanywa ngokwahlukileyo — ukuphambiwa kwenye inyanga akuthethi ukuba uza kuphambiwa nakwelandelayo.

Ukuba ufumana iCash Send: linda i-SMS voucher phambi kokuba uye kwivenkile
Sukuyivala okanye uyitshintshe iakhawunti yakho yebhanki de kufike intlawulo

contentBlocks.text: Emva kokuba isimo sakho sibonise 'uPhambiwe', ngokuqhelekileyo umhla wokuhlawula uyongezwa kwiintsuku nje ezimbalwa zomsebenzi. Imihla ngqo iyahluka ngokohlobo lwesibonelelo:

rows: Ixhasa lokuhlawula lonyanga lisiqala malunga nomhla wama-25
Iveki yokuqala yenyanga nganye, emva kwezibonelelo zabantu abadala nokhubazeka

contentBlocks.text: Kuthatha Ixesha Elingakanani Ukuba Ibonakale Kwiakhawunti Yakho Yebhanki?
Xa iSASSA icutshe ixesha lokuhlawula, ixesha elithathwa yimali ukuba ibonakale kwiakhawunti yakho lixhomekeke kwibhanki yakho:

rows: Ngolo suku lunye (kwiinyure ezi-2 ukuya kwezi-4 emva kokukhutshwa kweSASSA)
Ngolo suku lunye okanye usuku olulandelayo lomsebenzi

contentBlocks.text: Uphambiwe Ngaphandle Komhla Wokuhlawula — Ukuthetha Ntoni Nento Omawuyenze

Ukuba isimo sakho sibonisa 'uPhambiwe' kodwa akukho mhla wokuhlawula ubonakalayo ecaleni kwaso, isicelo sakho sigunyaziwe kule nyanga, kodwa umhla wokuhlawula akukabonakaliswa. Oku kwenzeka rhoqo kwaye akuthethi ukuba ukuphambiwa kwakho kurhoxisiwe. Kwiimeko ezininzi umhla wokuhlawula uyongezwa njengoko usuku lokuhlawula olulandelayo lusondela.

contentBlocks.title: Uphambiwe kodwa akukho mhla wokuhlawula ubonakalayo?
contentBlocks.text: Isicelo sakho sigunyaziwe, kodwa umhla wokuhlawula akukabonakaliswa. Akukho nto ifunekayo kuwe ngelixa ulindile — qhubeka ujonge isimo sakho rhoqo kwiintsuku ezimbalwa kunokuba ufune kwakhona.

Oku kwahlukile kwisimo 'sokuLimba', esithetha ukuba iSASSA isavavanya ukufaneleka kwakho kule nyanga. Kukwahlukile nakwintlawulo elahlekileyo: ukuba umhla wokuhlawula wawubonisiwe kwaye loo mhla udlulile kungabikho mali kwiakhawunti yakho, landela isikhokelo sethu sokuba intlawulo ingabonakali.

items: Sukungenisa isicelo esitsha — akusayi kwenza umhla wokuhlawula ubonakale kwangoko kwaye kunokwenza irekhodi lakho libe nzima
Sukubhatala nabani na obanga ukuba unokukhupha intlawulo yakho okanye anyanzelise ukuba kubonakale umhla wokuhlawula — oku bubuqhetseba obuqhelekileyo
Sukutshintsha iinkcukacha zakho zebhanki ngokuphindaphindiweyo ngelixa ulindile — utshintsho ngalunye luphinda luqale ukuqinisekiswa kwaye lunokutyhala intlawulo yakho iye kumjikelo olandelayo
Sukuxhomekeka kwizaziso ze-SMS kuphela — jonga isimo sakho ngqo kwiportal esemthethweni

contentBlocks.text: Akukho SMS Okwangoku? Ukuba Kutheni Oku Kunokuba Qhelekileyo

Izaziso zokuphambiwa zithunyelwa nge-SMS apho iSASSA inom nombolo yefowuni esebenzayo esemfayileni, kodwa imiyalezo ingafika kade okanye ingafiki konke — ingakumbi ukuba inombolo yakho itshintshile ukususela xa ubusenza isicelo. Iportal yesimo sisiseko esithembekileyo senyaniso: ukuba ibonisa 'uPhambiwe', thatha isibonelelo sakho njengesigunyaziweyo nokuba ingafikanga na i-SMS. Ukuba inombolo yakho itshintshile okanye ilahlekile, yihlaziya usebenzisa isikhokelo sethu senombolo yefowuni yeSRD ukuze izaziso ezizayo zifike kuwe.

faqs.question: Isimo sam sithi 'Siphambiwe' kodwa akukho mhla wokuhlawula. Kuthetha ntoni oku?
faqs.answer: Isicelo sakho sigunyaziwe, kodwa umhla wokuhlawula akukabonakaliswa. Oku kwenzeka rhoqo kwaye akukho nto ifunekayo kuwe. Ngokuqhelekileyo umhla wokuhlawula uyongezwa kwiintsuku ezimbalwa zomsebenzi njengoko usuku lokuhlawula olulandelayo lusondela — qhubeka ujonge isimo sakho kunokuba ufune kwakhona.

faqs.question: Ngaba isimo 'sokuPhambiwe' singatshintsha sibuyele 'kuLimba' okanye 'siNqatshelwe'?
faqs.answer: Ewe. Inyanga nganye ivavanywa njengomjikelo owahlukileyo. Ukuba imeko yakho yemali itshintsha phakathi kwenyanga (umzekelo, ufumana imali efakwa kwibhanki), inyanga elandelayo inokubonisa isimo esahlukileyo.

faqs.question: Ndiphambiwe kodwa imali ayikho kwiakhawunti yam. Ndifanele ukwenza ntoni?
faqs.answer: Linda iintsuku ezi-1 ukuya kwezi-3 zomsebenzi emva komhla wokuhlawula. Ukuba isengabonakali, qinisekisa ukuba iinkcukacha zakho zebhanki zichanekile kwaye iakhawunti iyasebenza. Ukuba ingxaki iyaqhubeka, qhagamshelana neSASSA.

faqs.question: Ngaba kufuneka ndiphinde ndifune kwakhona inyanga ngenyanga ukuba ndiphambiwe?
faqs.answer: Hayi. Xa sele uphambiwe, isibonelelo sakho sivavanywa ngokuzenzekelayo inyanga nganye. Kufuneka ufune kwakhona kuphela ukuba isibonelelo sakho sicinyiwe okanye kufuneka utshintshe uhlobo lwesibonelelo.

faqs.question: Ngaba ndingayitshintsha indlela yam yokuhlawula emva kokuphambiwa?
faqs.answer: Ewe. Ngena kwiportal yeSRD waye kwi 'Payment Method' ukuze utshintshe phakathi kogqithiso lwebhanki neCash Send. Utshintsho luqala ukusebenza ukususela kwinyanga elandelayo.
